metrics.name: clf_best_val_accuracy
metrics.meaning: classification test (Iris): validation accuracy of the final best model, as printed by tab_automl Trainer.model_checkpoint

metrics.name: reg_best_val_mse
metrics.meaning: regression test (Wine): validation MSE of the final best model, as printed by tab_automl Trainer.model_checkpoint

multiplicity: Bonferroni: distribution_change if any metric's p < alpha / number of metrics
provenance: Metrics chosen from the repository's test.py and tab_automl/automl/training.py at commit cada595 before any pilot N run. E2 had already run this repository; its records show that the printed scores vary between unchanged runs, which is why it is the pilot repository.
